description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú


O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.


Desafio:

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Suprimentos para atuar na aquisição de serviços florestais e facilities, garantindo eficiência, qualidade, competitividade e cumprimento das normas de compliance. Esta posição exige forte capacidade analítica, agilidade na adaptação e habilidade para construir relacionamentos sólidos com clientes internos e fornecedores.

Se você é uma pessoa proativa, colaborativa, comunicativa, comprometida e com forte espírito de trabalho em equipe, essa posição pode ser ideal para você.


Principais Atividades:


  • Realizar cotações, negociações e contratações de serviços florestais e facilities, aplicando as abordagens ao mercado e estratégia de negociação.
  • Atuar de forma próxima e colaborativa com clientes internos, promovendo um relacionamento de confiança e entendendo as necessidades da operação.
  • Identificar, prospectar e avaliar fornecedores, assegurando conformidade aos padrões de qualidade, segurança e capacidade operacional;
  • Desenvolver e fortalecer parcerias estratégicas com fornecedores, negociando SLAs, acompanhando contratos e conduzindo iniciativas para mitigação de riscos e otimização de custos.
  • Monitorar todo o ciclo de vida dos contratos, garantindo aderência a prazos, cláusulas e requisitos de compliance.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

title: ANALISTA GARANTIA DE QUALIDADE PL
description:

Aqui, valorizamos a diversidade como força propulsora da inovação e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde diferentes perspectivas se encontram para criar soluções mais humanas, equilibradas e transformadoras.


Ser Biorigin é ter a certeza de fazer parte da construção de um amanhã mais inteligente, responsável, equilibrado e humano, com pessoas que acreditam na potência da biotecnologia para transformar vidas e nutrir o mundo.

title: Especialista Técnico SAP I
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean): Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP.
  • Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes.
  • Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time.
  • Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP.
  • Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas.
  • Desenvolvimentos e Projetos: Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto.
  • Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações \"Z\" tradicionais em favor de extensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes.
  • Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance.
  • Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem.
  • Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno: Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+; Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views.
  • Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
  • Histórico de Liderança Técnica: Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes.
  • Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban.

title: Analista de Recursos Humanos Sênior
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


Atuar na área de Gente & Performance com atuação transversal nos processos de atração de talentos, treinamento e desenvolvimento e acompanhamento da jornada do colaborador, apoiando as áreas comerciais e matriciais da helloo na gestão de pessoas e evolução das equipes.

Ser responsável por conduzir processos de recrutamento e seleção, estruturar iniciativas de capacitação e desenvolvimento, acompanhar a jornada do colaborador e garantir a execução consistente das práticas de Gente & Performance. Contribuir para o fortalecimento da cultura, desenvolvimento de talentos e melhoria contínua da experiência do colaborador, utilizando indicadores e análises de pessoas para apoiar lideranças na tomada de decisão e na evolução da performance organizacional.

Atração

  • Conduzir processos de recrutamento e seleção, desde o alinhamento de perfil com as lideranças até a condução de entrevistas e acompanhamento da admissão.
  • Apoiar as áreas na definição de perfis profissionais alinhados às necessidades do negócio e à cultura.
  • Garantir uma boa experiência para candidatos ao longo do processo seletivo.
  • Apoiar o planejamento e acompanhamento das vagas, contribuindo para a gestão e controle de headcount.


Treinamento & Desenvolvimento

  • Diagnosticar necessidades de desenvolvimento das áreas da helloo (comerciais e matriciais), em parceria com lideranças e equipes, traduzindo demandas do negócio em iniciativas estruturadas de capacitação e desenvolvimento.
  • Desenhar e implementar soluções de aprendizagem, incluindo programas, treinamentos e trilhas de desenvolvimento, alinhadas às competências críticas para o negócio e às prioridades estratégicas da companhia.
  • Estruturar e desenvolver conteúdos e metodologias de aprendizagem, considerando diferentes públicos, formatos e abordagens educacionais que potencializem a absorção de conhecimento e sua aplicação prática no dia a dia.
  • Desenvolver e implementar programas de onboarding, garantindo integração eficiente de novos colaboradores, alinhamento à cultura e aceleração da curva de aprendizagem.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desenvolvimento e efetividade das iniciativas de capacitação, analisando resultados, engajamento e impacto na performance das áreas, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Assegurar qualidade técnica das iniciativas e alinhamento com as estratégias de Gente & Performance.
  • Contribuir para programas e iniciativas de desenvolvimento de liderança, cultura e diversidade, apoiando a evolução organizacional e o fortalecimento do ambiente de trabalho.


Processos e Jornada do Colaborador

  • Atuar junto a Coordenadores e Supervisores nos temas relacionados à gestão de pessoas e acompanhamento das equipes, apoiando lideranças na tomada de decisão e na condução de práticas de gestão.
  • Acompanhar a jornada do colaborador, incluindo onboarding, desenvolvimento, movimentações internas e demais momentos do ciclo de vida na companhia.
  • Apoiar líderes na condução de temas relacionados a engajamento, clima organizacional e gestão de performance, contribuindo para um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo.
  • Atuar como facilitador na implementação de iniciativas de cultura e comunicação interna, fortalecendo o alinhamento das equipes aos valores e direcionadores da companhia.
  • Conduzir as rotinas de Gente & Performance, incluindo processos de admissões, movimentações e desligamentos, garantindo organização, conformidade e fluidez nos processos.
  • Atuar em parceria com as áreas especialistas de Gente & Performance (Remuneração, Benefícios, Departamento Pessoal e Comunicação Interna), assegurando alinhamento e execução consistente das práticas da área.
  • Estruturar, analisar e interpretar indicadores de pessoas, gerando insights para as lideranças, apoiando na identificação e justificativa de desvios e contribuindo para decisões relacionadas à gestão das equipes.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Superior completo em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Psicologia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em áreas de Gente & Performance / Recursos Humanos, com atuação em diferentes subsistemas de pessoas;
  • Vivência em processos de recrutamento e seleção, desenvolvimento de pessoas e acompanhamento da jornada do colaborador;
  • Experiência no atendimento a lideranças e suporte na gestão de equipes;
  • Experiência na estruturação e acompanhamento de indicadores de pessoas, com capacidade de análise e geração de insights;
  • Excel em nível intermediário ou avançado para construção de análises e indicadores;
  • PowerPoint ou ferramentas de apresentação para consolidação de materiais e comunicação de iniciativas da área.


O Que Temos Para Você

title: AI Trainer
description:
We are looking for motivated individuals residing in Brazil to join our team as Freelance AI Trainers . This is an entry-level opportunity perfect for undergraduate students and freshers who are native Portuguese speakers and eager to contribute to the development of next-generation artificial intelligence.


Role Overview

As an AI Trainer, you will help improve the accuracy and quality of AI models by reviewing, labeling, and generating text-based content. Your insights as a native speaker are essential to ensuring the AI understands the nuances of the Portuguese language and Brazilian culture.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Labeling: Categorize and annotate text data to help the AI understand context and intent.
  • Content Evaluation: Review AI-generated responses for accuracy, tone, and grammatical correctness.
  • Writing & Rewriting: Create high-quality sample dialogues or prompts in native Portuguese.
  • Fact-Checking: Verify information to ensure the AI provides reliable and safe responses.


Requirements

  • Language: Native-level proficiency in Portuguese (written and verbal).
  • Location: Must be a current resident of Brazil .
  • Education: Currently enrolled in an undergraduate program or a recent graduate (Freshers are encouraged to apply!).
  • Skills: Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to follow complex guidelines.
  • Tech Savvy: Comfortable working with online platforms and basic productivity tools.
  • Equipment: Access to a reliable computer and high-speed internet.


Compensation & Benefits


  • Rate: $4 USD per hour .
  • Flexibility: Work from anywhere in Brazil with a schedule that fits your studies or other commitments.
  • Experience: Gain hands-on experience in the rapidly growing field of Artificial Intelligence.

title: Sr New Business Manager
description:
SR NEW BUSINESS MANAGER

Company: Worldpanel by Numerator


Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights e consultoria, que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo? Então essa é a sua chance!

title: Consultor(a) WMS Manhattan
description:
Sobre a NCS Partners 

A NCS Partners é líder em serviços profissionais de supply chain e parceira Platinum de consultoria da Manhattan Associates. Fundada em 2011 por uma equipe de liderança com mais de 25 anos de experiência com a Manhattan Associates, a NCSP cresceu para uma empresa global entregando resultados transformadores nas principais plataformas Manhattan — iSeries, Open Systems e Manhattan Active. Não apenas resolvemos problemas; construímos parcerias de longo prazo que abrangem Estratégia, Design, Testes, Implementação e Suporte contínuo. 

A NCSP Brasil é nossa unidade de negócios dedicada a atender clientes na América Latina, trazendo a mesma profundidade de expertise e compromisso para o mercado brasileiro e regional.


Sobre a Vaga 

Estamos buscando um(a) Consultor(a) Manhattan WMS para integrar nosso time em crescimento no Brasil. Nesta posição, você ajudará a desenhar, configurar e implementar soluções de gerenciamento de armazéns para empresas líderes utilizando as plataformas WMS da Manhattan Associates. 

Você trabalhará diretamente com clientes para entender suas necessidades de negócio, traduzindo-as em especificações técnicas, e entregando configurações e melhorias de alta qualidade que transformam operações da cadeia de suprimentos.


Responsabilidades  

• Analisar requisitos de negócio dos clientes e desenhar soluções WMS alinhadas às melhores práticas de gerenciamento de armazéns. 

• Configurar, testar e implementar soluções Manhattan WMi / WMOS / Manhattan Active Warehouse Management.

• Atuar em múltiplas frentes em projetos de implementação, incluindo suporte à configuração, testes funcionais e de integração, treinamento, suporte ao go-live e hypercare pós-implantação.

• Criar e manter documentos de design funcional, scripts de teste e materiais de treinamento.

• Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais de projeto (desenvolvedores, arquitetos, gerentes de projeto e stakeholders do cliente).

• Fornecer troubleshooting e suporte à produção durante e após o go-live.

• Contribuir para a melhoria contínua, identificando oportunidades de otimização nos processos de armazém dos clientes.

• Viajar para sites de clientes conforme necessário (estimativa de 20–40%, dependendo dos requisitos do projeto).


Requisitos  

• Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Logística, Supply Chain ou área correlata.

• Mínimo de 1 ano de experiência prática em implementação ou suporte a Manhattan Associates WMS (WMOS, WM for iSeries ou Manhattan Active WM).

• Conhecimento dos conceitos de gerenciamento de armazéns: recebimento, armazenagem (putaway), reabastecimento, alocação, separação (picking), embalagem (packing) e expedição.

• Familiaridade com banco de dados (DB2, Oracle SQL, PL/SQL) para consultas e troubleshooting básico.

• Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal em português e inglês.

• Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em equipes multifuncionais e multiculturais.

• Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais e internacionais conforme necessidade dos projetos.


Diferenciais  

• Experiência com implementações de Manhattan Active® Warehouse Management.

• Conhecimento de plataformas enterprise (servidores UNIX/Linux, bancos de dados Oracle).

• Proficiência em Oracle SQL e PL/SQL para desenvolvimento ou troubleshooting.

• Conhecimento em plataformas de API (POSTMAN e similares).

• Experiência com tecnologias de integração (APIs, EDI, middleware). Incluindo o uso de POSTMAN ou similar. 

• Familiaridade com módulos Manhattan como Labor Management, Slotting ou Supply Chain Planning.

title: Sales Enablement Specialist, Digital Course & Access Programs
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

JoVE is seeking a Sales Enablement Specialist - Digital Course Materials & Access Programs to support the operational delivery and adoption of JoVE’s digital science video platform across higher education institutions.

This role sits within the Sales Enablement team and focuses on managing course material adoptions, supporting bookstore affordability programs such as Inclusive Access and Equitable Access, and ensuring the reliable delivery of JoVE content through Learning Management Systems (LMS).

While JoVE’s Customer Success team works directly with faculty on course-level implementation, this role focuses on operational workflows, adoption tracking, data analysis, and identifying trends or systemic issues affecting digital course material delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational and analytical skills with meaningful experience working with LMS platforms and LTI-based integrations used in higher education courseware delivery.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage course material adoptions and digital product fulfillment across higher education accounts.
  • Support the implementation and administration of Inclusive Access and Equitable Access programs with university bookstores.
  • Coordinate course setup and delivery of digital materials through bookstore distribution systems.
  • Analyze sales, adoption, and fulfillment data to create reports and dashboards that support forecasting, planning, and decision-making.
  • Provide insights to Sales leadership on adoption performance and program growth.
  • Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities in bookstore and digital distribution workflows.
  • Monitor workflows that support JoVE content delivery through Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, D2L, etc.). Recommend process improvements and system enhancements to support scalable program delivery.
  • Apply working knowledge of LTI integrations and LMS courseware delivery models to diagnose access or authentication issues.


Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s degree
  • 3+ years experience in EdTech, digital publishing, sales operations, or academic technology environments
  • Strong familiarity with Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, Brightspace, etc.)
  • Demonstrated experience working with LTI integrations or LMS-based courseware delivery
  • Strong experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
  • Results-driven, strong organization and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently in a fast paced environment


Why JoVE?

  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Cloud AI/ML Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer to lead the automation of complex financial workflows at Prosigliere.


Description

We are seeking a Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer with a \"cloud-first\" mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just build models; you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services.

The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions.
  • Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data.
  • Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.g., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making.
  • Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements.
  • Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations.
  • Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow.


Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations.
  • Cloud-First Expertise: Proven experience with Vertex AI (GCP) , Azure AI , or AWS SageMaker , specifically utilizing high-level AI services (Document AI, Search/Discovery, etc.).
  • Data Integration: Proficiency in building API integrations and data pipelines that handle structured and unstructured data from external financial vendors.
  • Python Mastery: Expert-level Python skills, including experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building agentic AI workflows.
  • Visualization: Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components.
  • Security Mindset: Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments.


Profile Requirements

  • Solution Architect Mentality: Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap.
  • Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who can build \"the bridge\" when a standard out-of-the-box tool doesn't exist.
  • Strong Communication: Ability to explain why an AI made a specific recommendation to stakeholders.
  • Agile Learner: A commitment to staying current with the rapid pace of LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI developments.
  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with AI-first engineering approaches and tooling is a plus. If you are familiar with the Cognition platform with Windsurf and Devin, that is even better.
  • Certifications: Google, Azure or AWS Cloud AI certifications are a big plus!

title: Analista de PCM PL

O Analista de PCM PL será responsável por planejar, programar e acompanhar as atividades de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva dos ativos, garantindo as metas de disponibilidade operacional e confiabilidade das usinas sob gestão da Metrion.

O que diferencia você?


  • Experiência em O&M de energia renovável (Solar/CGH).

title: Engenheiro de Testes e Calibração
description:
SOBRE A VAGA:

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro de Testes e Calibração para garantir alta disponibilidade, confiabilidade e performance dos equipamentos de teste, atuando de forma estratégica na gestão, calibração e manutenção de toda a cadeia de medição — incluindo sensores, cabos, condicionamento de sinal e sistemas de aquisição de dados (DAQ) .

Esta posição é referência técnica na área, apoiando engenheiros e técnicos na seleção, configuração e uso correto da instrumentação , além de liderar iniciativas de melhoria contínua e evolução tecnológica do parque de testes.


FORMAÇÃO

Formação superior completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Elétrica/Eletrônica ou áreas correlatas.


RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Gerir o ciclo de vida dos equipamentos de teste e instrumentação , incluindo inventário, criticidade, padrões, documentação e rastreabilidade.
  • Planejar e executar calibração e manutenção preventiva/corretiva , assegurando conformidade metrológica e máxima disponibilidade dos sistemas.
  • Realizar diagnóstico de falhas e troubleshooting em sensores, cabos, conectores, DAQ e condicionamento de sinal, garantindo qualidade e repetibilidade das medições.
  • Configurar e comissionar sistemas de aquisição de dados conforme demanda dos testes, com suporte a setups em bancada e em veículo.
  • Definir e manter procedimentos, instruções e padrões de instrumentação , incluindo boas práticas de medição, montagem, inspeção e armazenamento.
  • Treinar e suportar engenheiros e técnicos , promovendo o uso eficiente e correto dos sistemas de medição.
  • Conduzir análises de obsolescência e necessidades futuras , elaborando roadmaps e apoiando solicitações de investimento para atualização e expansão do parque de testes.
  • Atuar como interface técnica com fornecedores e sites globais , alinhando tecnologias, métodos e requisitos locais.


REQUISITOS

  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação) para interação com times globais e fornecedores.
  • Experiência prática com equipamentos de teste e instrumentação , incluindo sensores (temperatura, pressão, aceleração, strain gages, entre outros).
  • Conhecimento sólido em metrologia e rotina de calibração (rastreabilidade, certificados, tolerâncias e gestão de intervalos).
  • Vivência com sistemas de aquisição de dados (DAQ) , incluindo configuração e troubleshooting (cabeamento, conectores, ruído, aterramento e integridade de sinal).
  • Perfil organizado, com capacidade de planejamento, priorização e gestão de documentação .
  • Boa comunicação, postura de atendimento ao cliente interno e colaboração com engenheiros e técnicos.


DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência com ferramentas/fornecedores de DAQ como Dewesoft ou IPETRONIK .
  • Familiaridade com barramentos e protocolos veiculares (CAN, Ethernet, LIN).


CARGO

Analista de Testes e Calibração


CONTRATAÇÃO E BENEFÍCIOS

  • Contrato CLT;
  • Refeição no local;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Horário: 2ª a 6ª das 08:00 às 17:15 (100% presencial);

title: Systems Engineer
description:
As THE leader in transit technology, Clever Devices' vision is to make meaningful contributions to worldwide mobility. Our goal is to be the leading provider of exciting technology that improves the quality of mobility in communities around the world.


This role will cover either our open B (4PM - 12PM) and C (12PM-8AM) shift as well as weekends.


Job Summary:

The Systems Engineer is responsible for leading the deployment of complete systems that include Clever Devices products combined with complementary technologies, including deployment of hardware products and interfaces, to provide a holistic solution that meets customer requirements.

The Systems Engineer works closely with the project team to analyze the customer requirements and required functionality early in the project cycle; create design documents, system architecture, requirement matrix and support the customer design reviews, conduct the Factory Acceptance Testing with the customer and lead the subsequent deployment at the Customer site. Execute and complete the System Acceptance Testing along with the customer and all other parties involved in the project

The Systems Engineer coordinates all system development and integration tasks to include design, integration and formal testing. The Systems Engineer also works to support the Systems Engineering team.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Supports the definition of software and hardware products and interfaces
  • Coordinates system development tasks to include design, integration and formal testing
  • Oversees all transitions into customer’s deployment
  • Develops and completes projects in system specifications, technical and logistical requirements and other disciplines
  • Creates and maintains programmatic and technical documentation (design docs, requirement matrix, system diagrams, etc) to insure efficient planning and execution
  • Manages and documents system configurations
  • Ensures the deployment of the solution is successful
  • Maintains a thorough working knowledge of enterprise applications such as BusTime and CleverCAD
  • Implements Performance analysis and reliability analysis of the end to end protocol
  • Adheres to protocol revisions and amendments as directed by the Regional Systems Engineering Manager
  • Assists in other tasks as needed by the Systems Engineering department
  • Provides training and guidance to Associates, Project Engineer I/II as needed.


Skills Required:

  • 10+ years experience in engineering development
  • 10+ years experience in systems engineering involving hardware, software, data and communications technologies
  • Good understanding of the J1939 and J1708 protocols and experience with Multiplex systems
  • Hardware design experience and ability to read electrical schematics
  • Experience with hardware troubleshooting and lab equipment
  • Experience with network and protocol troubleshooting and tools
  • Working knowledge of one or more of the following: C and C++, SQL, VB, JavaScript, HTML, ASP, python, databases, report generation and networking
  • Ability to independently gather and document requirements and provide design requirements and product definition
  • Strong computer skills particularly with MS Office including Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint and Project.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize
  • Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills
  • Strong written and oral communication skills
  • Bachelors Degree in Engineering or Computer Engineering required, Masters Degree in related discipline.
  • Experience working with public transit is a plus


Clever Devices is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.


The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Senior Mobile Developer
description:
Senior Mobile Developer


Role Purpose

As a Mobile Developer Senior Developer you will be responsible for architecting and building high performance enterprise grade mobile applications within the Experience Engineering and Digital Emerging Tech portfolios. This role focuses on leveraging React Native and the Salesforce Mobile SDK to deliver offline first data rich applications for a global FMCG leader. You will integrate advanced capabilities like OpenCV for image processing and manage complex local data using Smart Store, ensuring a seamless mobile experience within a hyper scaler heavy application landscape.


Key Responsibilities

  • CrossPlatform Development: Design and develop robust mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native
  • Salesforce Integration: Implement and customize mobile solutions using the Salesforce Mobile SDK ensuring seamless synchronization between mobile devices and Salesforce clouds
  • Offline Data Management: Architect Offline First capabilities using Smart Store DB, Salesforce SmartStore and SmartSync to manage complex local data persistence and synchronization
  • Computer Vision Integration: Implement image processing and computer vision features, eg shelf scanning asset recognition or document processing using OpenCV within the mobile environment
  • State Management: Manage complex application states and data flows using Redux or Redux Toolkit
  • Experience Engineering: Build highfidelity responsive UIs that provide superior user journeys for fieldforce users and consumers adhering to global brand standards
  • Version Control CI/CD: Manage source code branching strategies and pull requests using GitHub integrated with automated mobile build pipelines
  • Emerging Tech Pilots: Support Digital Emerging Technology initiatives by prototyping mobile first AIML features and integrating with hyper scaler hosted APIs eg GCP Vision AI
  • Senior Developer Specifics: Lead technical design for mobile modules perform rigorous code reviews, optimize app performance, memory battery and mentor junior developers in mobile best practices


Primary Skills Must-Have

  • Core Framework: Expert level proficiency in React Native JavaScriptTypeScript
  • Salesforce: Mobile Hands on experience with Salesforce Mobile SDK and Smart Store DB
  • State Management: Deep understanding of Redux for enterprisescale mobile apps
  • Computer Vision: Experience integrating OpenCV or similar CNative modules into React Native applications
  • Version Control: Advanced proficiency in GitHub workflows and Gitbased collaboration


Secondary Skills Good-to-Have

  • Native Modules: Ability to write Native Bridges in SwiftObjectiveC iOS or JavaKotlin Android
  • Hyperscaler Exposure: Experience connecting mobile apps to GCPAzure backend services Cloud Run App Services
  • Salesforce Platform: Familiarity with Apex SOQL and Salesforce Lightning Web Components LWC
  • Mobile Security: Knowledge of OAuth2 Certificate Pinning and secure local storage patterns
  • FMCG Domain: Understanding of retail execution van sales or fieldforce automation workflows

title: Demand Planner
description:
DEMAND PLANNER


DyStar is seeking to fulfill a key role to support the Supply Chain Manager for Brazil. The successful candidate will have 2 years international planning and replenishment experience. This is an on-site role in Sao Paulo (not open to remote or hybrid work).


Must be able to communicate in English with the Americas Regional Headquarters in the United States and with the Global Headquarters in Singapore- must have good skills in writing and speaking.


Job Summary:

  • Perform Demand Planning and Replenishment activities of Finished Goods based on Actual Sales, Forecast, Inventory on hand, material in transit, open Purchase Orders and Production Lead Time in order to determine the optimum size of inventory in accordance with Global and Regional parameters.
  • Place Purchase Orders in accordance to Demand Planning needs, and guarantee correct follow up of each one of them, as to accomplish timely delivery of the material to the required plants.
  • Control and manage all aspects of planning activities, maintain correct inventory levels to support company goals and customer service needs, as well as avoid/minimize over stock, unhealthy inventory and short supply
  • Assist with maintenance of data bases in MRP and guarantee Open POs are maintained at minimum levels. Attend priority and planning meetings, outage coordination meetings and scheduled review meetings and be prepared to actively participate as required.


Supervisory Responsibilities: None


Job Responsibilities:

  • Prepare correct information for the monthly planning meeting to support the monthly planning activities, ensuring the participation and communication with Sales, Marketing, BM and related areas together with the SCM team with the objective to propose replenishment at adequate quantities and guarantee delivery of products in timely manner in accordance to Global and Regional requirements.
  • Elaborate and update the planning report to be presented in S&OP meetings, which contains: products, sales, forecast, inventory in all plants related to the planning scope, production schedule per product, material in transit, open purchase orders, new orders to be placed, overstock and stock transfers (between plants)
  • Elaborate and update the purchase orders report as to follow each line item in the purchase order with pre allocation or allocation date, or production schedule, shipping details, documents corresponding to each shipment (invoice, packing list, B/L, COA, etc.)
  • Follow DOA (Delegation of Authority) process when entering Purchasing Requisition or Purchase Orders.
  • In case of airfreight orders needed, request corresponding authorization as per DOA, before placement
  • Ensures critical analysis of inventory levels to support Company goals and manages the development of creative solutions to anticipate inventory short supply issues
  • Prepares Unhealthy Inventory Reports monthly to be presented to Business Managers and Sales Teams so Unhealthy Inventory can be properly managed, and necessary actions are timely addressed
  • Creates, monitors, and maintains S&OP metrics and key performance indicators, identifying resulting risks and opportunities
  • Helps to develop advanced analytical tools and reporting figures to support the entire planning and purchasing process
  • Facilitate cross-functional communication among the Business Units, Supply Chain and Local teams in support of major Planning & Purchasing initiatives, factory productivity, inventory levels, distribution, transportation, etc.
  • Reviews short/mid/long term demand plans, follows up on their execution with Sales team and Business Managers to align forecast outlook.
  • Analyzes internal demand stream information and categorizes according to demand patterns.
  • Gets consensus forecast among Sales/Marketing/Business Managers and Supply Chain.
  • Aligns Production Schedule of Suppliers and Production Facilities with Purchasing Plan in order to take the best benefit of freight charges and shipping opportunities.
  • Manages and coordinates Process Improvements initiatives based on Lean Manufacturing concepts
  • Coordinates development and homologation processes of new Service Providers


Experience and Education Requirements:

• A degree in International Trade, International Business, International Relations or related degree and

• 2 years of experience in International Planning and Replenishment or equivalent experience.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Excellent analytical skills

• Excellent computer skills, with advanced skill in MS Excel

• Bilingual Portuguese-English required

• Excellent oral and written communication skills

• SAP (Not mandatory but nice to have it)

title: AI Agent Manager (Media)
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

The AI Agent Manager serves as the key technical and strategic resource for the company’s AI applications, with a focus on designing, building, operating, and managing complex AI agents. This role translates high-level business requirements into functional AI agent architectures, manages the full agent lifecycle (including advanced prompting, tooling, maintenance, and performance optimization), and ensures robust, measurable business outcomes.

The Manager owns the agent-building roadmap, advanced prompt engineering, agent configuration and deployment, performance monitoring, and cross-functional coordination to drive successful AI adoption across the organization.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Main Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and agents using low-code/no-code and prompt-based platforms (e.g., multi-step prompt systems, agent frameworks).
  • Translate business requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions, especially for internal process automation (e.g., media planning, operations, finance workflows).
  • Configure and optimize multi-step AI prompts (“blueprints”) to automate complex tasks across different tools and systems.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to understand use cases and define solution logic.
  • Act as a bridge between business teams and technical infrastructure, ensuring solutions are usable by non-technical users.
  • Test, iterate, and improve AI agents to ensure reliability, accuracy, and performance in real-world use cases.
  • Identify opportunities for automation across departments and proactively propose AI-driven improvements.
  • Document workflows, prompt logic, and system configurations for internal reuse and scalability.
  • Stay up to date with advancements in AI tools, LLM capabilities, and no-code/low-code ecosystems.


Core Requirements

  • 4–7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, System Analyst, or similar role.
  • Strong ability to translate business processes into structured workflows and logic.
  • Hands-on experience with low-code/no-code tools (e.g., Zapier, Make, Airtable, Retool, or similar platforms).
  • Experience working with AI tools (LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI automation platforms).
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and own end-to-end solution delivery.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)
  • Technical / AI-Related
  • Experience designing multi-step prompts or AI workflows (not just single prompts).
  • Understanding of how LLMs work and how to structure prompts for reliable outputs.
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and automation tools is a plus.
  • Basic programming knowledge is helpful but not required.
  • Soft Skills
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Business-oriented mindset with a focus on practical outcomes.
  • Curiosity and willingness to experiment with new AI tools and approaches.
  • Ability to operate in an ambiguous, fast-evolving environment.
  • Domain Experience
  • Experience in digital media, advertising tech, or media planning.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Proven ability to design, build, and operate sophisticated AI agents.
  • Expertise in advanced prompt engineering, including multi-step prompting, few-shot learning, and optimizing for specific model outputs.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.
  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Purchasing Manager
description:
SWM International is a multinational company specialized in producing paper for the tobacco industry and solutions in specialty papers. We are expert manufacturers of a variety of advanced materials that are part of people’s everyday lives. We contribute to our customers’ success by delivering high-quality products and collaborating to provide innovative and customized solutions that enhance the value of their offerings.


Now, we invite you to be part of our daily journey, where each employee is essential to the success of our company.


Bring your talent to SWM!

We are currently looking for a Purchasing Manager to join our team in a permanent position at our unit in Piraí, Rio de Janeiro.


Position Objective

Lead regional operational buying teams in executing global procurement strategies while managing supplier relationships locally and interfacing with key stakeholders like plant operational and maintenance teams. This role ensures compliance, operational excellence, cost optimization, and supply continuity by bridging the gap between corporate global strategy and regional business needs.


Your challenges will include:

1. Operational Leadership & Strategy Execution

  • Manage Regional Buying Teams: Lead and develop the operational procurement team to ensure high performance, process compliance, and professional growth.
  • Implement global framework agreement: work closely with category leaders to roll out global contracts regionally, ensuring local requirements are met without compromising global leverage.
  • Drive orocess excellence: Apply Lean/Six Sigma principles to streamline the \"procure-to-pay\" cycle and improve regional buying efficiency.

2. Market Intelligence & Analysis

  • Monitor market trends: Analyze regional indices, competitor behavior, and technical developments to forecast price fluctuations and supply risks.
  • Benchmarking: Regularly compare regional pricing and commercial terms against competitors to maintain a competitive edge while ensuring full legal and anti-trust compliance.
  • Data-driven reporting: Consolidate market research and internal KPIs into actionable monthly reports to guide executive decision-making.

3. Supplier & Stakeholder Management

  • Local face to suppliers: Act as the primary regional point of contact for key suppliers to resolve escalations, conduct performance reviews, and ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are met.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify supply chain bottlenecks and develop alternative sourcing formulations or backup plans.
  • Sourcing: Lead team to run competitive tenders for categories under direct responsibility

4. Continuous Improvement & Compliance

  • Knowledge Leadership: Stay current on industry innovations and digital procurement tools to suggest improvements in commercial positioning.
  • EHS & Quality Standards: Ensure all regional purchasing activities strictly adhere to Health, Safety, Environment, and corporate governance guidelines.
  • Compliance: Establish and enforce local procedures, ensuring transparency in the purchasing activities



What we’re looking for:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Engineering, or related fields
  • Experience: Solid knowledge of purchasing processes, negotiation, and import/export regulations;
  • Technical Skills: Training in Purchasing and Supply Chain/ Proficiency in Microsoft Office/ Experience with ERP and P2P softwares.
  • Languages: Fluency in English, any other language is a plus
  • Availability to travel.


What we offer:

  • Eye Care: Reimbursement of up to R$ 544.00 (frames and lenses) per year.
  • Group Life Insurance: Sul América Insurance, with monthly employee contribution through payroll deduction.
  • Dental Plan: Amil 700, family, with national coverage.

  • Christmas gift card

title: EHS Supervisor
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company’s business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

20+ R&D and operations centers

50+ manufacturing bases

80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally

10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity

Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms

Over 50% of the international workforce


Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision’s smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world’s largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).



Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise daily EHS activities on-site, ensuring compliance with safety standards and procedures
  • Conduct risk assessments and ensure proper control measures for high-risk activities (e.g., work at height, lifting operations, electrical works)
  • Monitor contractor activities and enforce EHS requirements
  • Perform regular site inspections and safety audits
  • Lead incident reporting and support investigations, ensuring corrective actions are implemented
  • Promote safety awareness through toolbox talks and on-site training
  • Ensure compliance with local regulations and company EHS policies
  • Support emergency preparedness, including drills and response coordination

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or technical qualification in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, or related fields
  • Experience in EHS within wind farm, construction, or energy projects is preferred
  • Strong knowledge of high-risk activities (lifting, working at heights, electrical safety)
  • Familiarity with local EHS regulations and standards
  • Experience supervising contractors on-site
  • Advanced English (to be tested)
  • Availability to work on-site and travel as required

title: ANALISTA MERCHANDISING/BUYER
description:
A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.


⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO


Responsável por realizar compra das coleções e acompanhamento dos indicadores da área de produto, como OTB, compras, vendas, cash flow, margem, Sell Thru e Loss end. Garantir a correta precificação e alocação de produtos na loja, bem como treinamento para equipe de loja. Ter contato direto com a loja e demais áreas que possuem interação para garantir o alinhamento 360° em relação a produto e a otimização da venda/giro. Responsável pela movimentaçao entre estoques, garantindo a acuracidade da oferta em cada canal. Responsável pela interface com o Iguatemi365, no que tange aos kpis da área: oferta, precificação, disponibilidade de produtos, giro, venda por produto.


RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?


Realizar a concepção do OTB (open to buy) diante da projeção e vendas determinada, considerando marca, coleções, categorias, subcategorias, itens, grade. Para acuracidade, deve considerar analise de histórico e tendências.

Realizar o processo de compra de produtos. Receber material da nova coleção, entender a inspiração junto a marca, analisar vendas e definir qual será o investimento de cada categoria (+subcategoria, itens, grade). Avaliar tendências e integrar equipe de varejo na definição dos produtos.

Realizar a precificação de produtos em linha com as premissas definidas e alinhadas com a marca e internamente determinadas pela iRetail. Sugerir as premissas adequadas para cada marca e momento, para tanto é necessário entender o mercado, analisar concorrência, para garantir que atingiremos os resultados definidos em budget.

Estar frequentemente em loja para acompanhar as vendas dos produtos junto à equipe de loja (in loco na loja), olhar tanto quantitativo quanto qualitativo, avaliar a exposição dos mesmos, reforçar o treinamento da equipe sobre a marca e os produtos. Propor sugestões de ações internas para melhoria do giro dos produtos (kpi); conectar frequentemente com Varejo e Marketing para discutir oportunidade e viabilidade de ações. Proatividade na busca de soluções para melhor girar produto.

Acompanhar o mercado de varejo, como ações e preços de concorrentes. Fazer uma análise crítica com relação ao que estamos praticando e, se necessário, propor mudanças.

Responsável pelo conhecimento das informações relacionadas a produto, assim como o treinamento da equipe. Garantir o conhecimento de todos os envolvidos no prazo necessário para que consigam agir em suas respectivas áreas.

Conhecer as clientes das marcas sob sua responsabilidade (grau de relacionamento de acordo com a tipo de cliente, construir relacionamento com as marcas)

Garantir junto a área de Operações o recebimento dos produtos nos prazos necessários. Acompanhar todos os embarques e entender impactos de possíveis atrasos nos recebimentos e lidar com o Controle de Qualidade (processos, interface loja, com a marca e solicitar os devidos reembolsos).

Participar e contribuir em ações da marca (como eventos etc), garantindo excelência e ganho de conhecimento.


Garantir acuracidade nas informações quantitativas e qualitativas, na frequência demandada.

Disponibilidade para viajar para os markets das marcas - frequência tbc.

title: Engenheiro de processos sênior
description:
A Borborema Recursos Estratégicos é uma empresa brasileira que nasceu para transformar possibilidades em realidade. Desde 2021, atuamos na Bahia com foco em pesquisa mineral de terras raras, minerais essenciais para tecnologias modernas e para a transição energética.

Nosso objetivo é unir inovação, responsabilidade e eficiência para construir um futuro sustentável. Somos subsidiárias da Brazilian Rare Earths e trabalhamos para posicionar o Brasil como protagonista no setor.


MISSÃO DO CARGO:

Desenvolver estudos e análises complexas, relacionados às atividades no campo da engenharia de processos, respondendo por identificar e quantificar recursos minerais, desenvolvendo projetos de beneficiamento de minérios e metalurgia de terras raras e elementos estratégicos, por meio da realização de estudos técnicos e análises críticas de processos, para viabilizar a produção sustentável de minérios e compostos metálicos com abrangência em toda a operação da empresa, e garantir implementação de melhorias em processos e novas tecnologias.


RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO

Suportar as atividades de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de rotas de processo de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia aplicáveis ao processo de produção de elementos de terras raras e minerais estratégicos em escala de bancada, piloto e industrial, visando otimização e inovação.


Acompanhar a realização de testes metalúrgicos de beneficiamento mineral ou metalurgia em laboratórios internos, externos e Centros de Pesquisa, garantindo a qualidade dos processos e atendendo às demandas de P&D da empresa.


Revisar documentação de projetos de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia nas diversas fases (Scoping Study até Feasibility Study), apoiando na elaboração e revisão de fluxogramas de processo e engenharia, com o objetivo de assegurar a precisão técnica dos estudos.


Atuar de forma consultiva juntamente ao corpo técnico, direcionando na elaboração e execução de programas de testes metalúrgicos e na avaliação e consolidação de informações de processos, contribuindo para a eficiência operacional.


Elaborar e revisar relatórios e apresentações para suportar as decisões da Gerência de Processos e P&D, comunicando os resultados de forma clara e objetiva para a tomada de decisões estratégicas.


Apoiar a equipe de Engenharia, Engenharia de Minas e PMO nos estudos da disciplina de Processos para planta de beneficiamento mineral e hidrometalurgia, fornecendo suporte técnico e contribuindo para a resolução de problemas.


Cumprir e fazer cumprir as normas e metas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente, promovendo uma cultura organizacional de responsabilidade e prevenção.


Participar ativamente na formação e desenvolvimento da equipe técnica, disseminando conhecimentos e melhorando as competências do time em processos de beneficiamento mineral.


REQUISITOS DO CARGO

title: Corporate Travel Agent
description:
About Us


We are a leading provider of energy efficient, innovative equipment, instrumentation, and process control systems to the global mining industry. With companies in Brazil, Chile, Mexico, and South Africa, Woodgrove has built a reputation based on quality, performance, and safety. The company is entrepreneurial, dynamic and our team are driven to succeed. We are looking for like-minded individuals that want to be part of a transformational business.


Role Summary

Assist employees with booking, reservations, visas process, documentation and itinerary paperwork, filing receipts, and documentation. The person will be constantly communicating with employees, airlines, hotels, and travel agents. The intern will help assuring that Woodgrove Travel Polices are followed. 



Essential Responsibilities

  • Employee’s Interaction:
  • Assist employees with inquiries, bookings, and travel-related information via phone, email, or in person.
  • Provide excellent customer service by addressing employee concerns, questions, and requests promptly and professionally.
  • Help employees select suitable travel options based on their preferences, budget, and requirements.
  • Booking and Reservation:
  • Assist in booking flights, accommodations, transportation, tours, and other travel-related services.
  • Input booking details accurately into reservation systems and databases.
  • Confirm reservations and ensure that all necessary information is provided to clients.
  • Itinerary Planning:
  • Collaborate with travel team to create customized travel itineraries for employees.
  • Arrange and coordinate various travel components, including flights, hotels, activities, and transfers, to create a seamless travel experience.
  • Documentation and Paperwork:
  • Prepare and organize necessary travel documents, such as tickets, itineraries, visas, and insurance.
  • Ensure that employees have all the required documentation for their trips and provide guidance on visa and entry requirements.
  • Research and Information:
  • Stay updated on travel trends, destinations, and industry developments to provide accurate and relevant information to clients.
  • Research and gather information about destinations, attractions, and local customs to assist clients in making informed decisions.
  • Administrative Support:
  • Assist with administrative tasks such as data entry, filing, and record keeping.
  • Manage and organize travel-related paperwork, invoices, and receipts.
  • Communication and Coordination:
  • Communicate with vendors, airlines, hotels, and other service providers to ensure accurate bookings and resolve any issues that may arise.
  • Coordinate logistics and communicate travel arrangements to clients.
  • Problem Solving:
  • Help resolve travel-related issues or disruptions that clients may encounter during their trips.
  • Offer alternative solutions and options when faced with unexpected changes or challenges.


Qualifications/Requirements

  • Education:  Tourism, administration, marketing or corelated areas
  • Language:  English – Advanced Mandatory
  • Spanish is a differential               
  • Experience with travel planning
  • Proficient in company portals: E-latam, E-Gol, Azul, Passaredo, and the Wooba portal.
  • Experience in planning customized domestic and international travel.
  • Experience in Customer Success is a diferential

title: Finance Analyst - Collection, Finance
description:
About Voxy


Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.


Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.


We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you’re on board, we would be happy to discuss.


You can find additional information about our values at this link (


The Impact You’ll Have at Voxy

Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.


What You’ll Be Doing:

Collections & Cash Application:

• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.

• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.

• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.

• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP&A Manager.

• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.

• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.

• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.


Credit Analysis & Risk Management:

• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.

• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.

• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.


Reporting & Analysis:

• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.

• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.

• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.

• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP&A Manager or Senior FP&A Analyst.


What We’re Looking For:

• B.A/B.S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;

• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;

• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;

• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;

• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;

• Based anywhere in Brazil

• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish

• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.


Job Details:

• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year

• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)


In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you’ll enjoy:

• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)

• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events

• Remote friendly work policies

• Professional development budget

• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify

• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world

• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)


We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.


Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.


In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.


As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.

This role is a fit for you if

  • You are a builder first

We’d love to hear from engineers who want to build serious AI systems in the real world.

title: Analista de Produto de Previdência Sênior
description:
Criada em 2011, a Zurich Santander Insurance America é uma joint venture entre os grupos Zurich e Banco Santander, dois dos maiores conglomerados do mundo nos setores de seguros e financeiro. Principais responsabilidades:
